entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.code_description: Soil and land preparation works; clearance works
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Levelling the agricultural land, which ensures a flat surface of the crop land, by reducing the micro-relief deviations caused by the other agricultural works; Soil scarification or deep loosening on compacted soils; Unclogging the soil at great depths, in order to favor the roots growth. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and points 14, 21, 22 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.

entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Arrangement of water sources for the animals on meadows, parcelling of meadows; Draining services. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and points 28, 42 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022, respectively in Order no. 157/2011.
